subject.title: [Bug]: Agent / sessions_spawn tool_use can emit with no matching tool_result and no parent-visible signal — silent subagent drop (~3.8% historical rate)

question: Should #94153 be the canonical durable completion-announcement design while #88856 stays open until the model-visible tool_use/tool_result failure contract is implemented across all silent-drop paths?
rationale: The remaining work changes model-facing parent context and delivery ownership across gateway, agent, transcript, task, and channel paths; automation should not choose that contract unilaterally while several overlapping PRs are open.

options.title: Keep #88856 Open And Canonicalize #94153 Direction
options.body: Use #94153 as the durable implementation tracker and keep this issue open until the final contract closes the orphaned tool_result and parent wake cases together.

options.title: Split Into Narrow Trackers
options.body: Keep this issue as an umbrella but require each open PR to link a narrower issue for its exact failure mode and proof boundary.

options.title: Close After One Partial PR Lands
options.body: Close this issue when the first wake or no-output PR merges, accepting follow-up issues for remaining orphan and pairing cases.

recommendation.title: Keep #88856 Open And Canonicalize #94153 Direction
recommendation.body: Use #94153 as the durable implementation tracker and keep this issue open until the final contract closes the orphaned tool_result and parent wake cases together.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent task delivery policy work and related delivery-contract reviews make this the best available routing signal for the product boundary decision.
